Fill gaps in rain or evaporation

Source: R/prepare.R
fill_gaps.Rd

The model cannot run through a gap in its inputs, so rain and evaporation must be complete before registration. Flow need not be: missing flow is simply left out of scoring, so never fill flow for scoring.

Usage

fill_gaps(
  x,
  rule = c("stop", "zero", "interpolate", "none"),
  time = NULL,
  label = "series",
  max_gap_h = Inf,
  dt = 1
)

Arguments

x

Numeric series on a regular step.

rule

One of the rules above.

time

Optional times of x, to name the gaps by date.

label

Name of the series in messages and notes.

max_gap_h

For interpolate: longest gap to fill, in hours, with dt.

dt

Time step in hours, for max_gap_h.

Value

x with gaps filled, noted.

Details

ruleDoes
stoprefuses, listing the five longest gaps, so you infill them yourself
zerosets missing steps to zero, for rain where a gap is known to be dry
interpolatejoins the values either side; gaps over max_gap_h stay missing
noneleaves gaps, and notes how many there are

The rule, the number of steps filled and the longest gap are noted, and reach the calibration log through register_data().

See also

zero_negatives(), preparation_notes()

Examples

fill_gaps(c(0.1, NA, NA, 0.4), "interpolate", label = "pet")
#> [1] 0.1 0.2 0.3 0.4
#> attr(,"pdm_prep")
#>   step
#> 1 gaps
#>                                                                                            detail
#> 1 pet: 2 missing steps in 1 gap, longest row 2 for 2 steps; interpolate, 2 filled, 0 left missing
